opportunities.description: Back to Previous Opportunity Details Community Partnerships Intern Keep Orlando Beautiful 0 similar opportunities Similar Opportunities Description Keep Orlando Beautiful is searching for a Community Partnerships Intern to assist in securing new community partnerships for ongoing community efforts, including litter cleanups and public school STEM education projects. This position is for the Fall semester with flexible dates depending on intern availability. This internship will run for a 12-week term with flexible start and end dates. This is an unpaid volunteer opportunity and may be eligible for college credit. It is the student''s responsibility to arrange college credit with their institution. Learn and stay up to date on Keep Orlando Beautiful programs and events to share with new community partners. Develop a community partner database to track outreach in collaboration with Keep Orlando Beautiful staff. Prepare and assist with upcoming events including community cleanups, workshops, and our annual fundraiser Trash 2 Trends. Answer and direct incoming emails and calls.
